rules.name: Dependency Confusion Attack
rules.description: Detection rules for software supply chain attacks: dependency confusion, typosquatting, compromised packages
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "dependency" or CommandLine contains "confusion" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-SUPPLY_CHAIN-057
